facts.value: Obtains Fighter from gobj->user_data and directly compares the float dmg.x1830_percent with p_ftCommonData->x488. The result selects CliffJumpQuick1 or CliffJumpSlow1. Calls Fighter_ChangeMotionState(gobj, msid, Ft_MF_None, 0, 1, 0, NULL), ftAnim_8006EBA4(gobj), and ftCommon_8007E2F4(fp, 32), then sets x221D_b7 and calls ftCo_CliffCatch_Phys(gobj). No integral-damage-to-float conversion is expressed or required by the declared damage type.
facts.rationale: Repairs the baseline conversion claim while preserving the exact ordered reads, calls and writes.

facts.value: Selects CliffJumpQuick1 only when damage < p_ftCommonData->x488 is true; equality, greater values and unordered comparison select CliffJumpSlow1. Shared initialization sets x221D_b7 and immediately invokes CliffCatch physics. A valid ledge produces ledge-relative positioning, while an invalid ledge calls ftCo_Fall_Enter before this helper returns. If phase one remains active until animation exhaustion, its Anim callback invokes normal phase-two entry; that helper maps exactly Quick1 to Quick2 and every other incoming motion to Slow2.
facts.rationale: Adds exceptional comparison behavior and the delegated early exit omitted by the baseline.

evidence.why: Threshold, initialization, animation guard and phase mapping.

facts.value: Selects Quick2 only for incoming Quick1, otherwise Slow2. Calls Fighter_ChangeMotionState with Ft_MF_None, 0, 1, 0, NULL and ftAnim_8006EBA4, clears mv.co.cliffjump.x0, then assigns self_vel.y = co_attrs.ledge_jump_vertical_velocity * force_mul. There is no local X assignment, clamp, sign restriction or finite check. Zero, negative and exceptional floating-point multipliers are not rejected. The next phase-two physics invocation sets the latch without calling ft_80084DB0; later invocations delegate. Animation completion calls ftCo_Fall_Enter rather than guaranteeing a particular final motion.
facts.rationale: Replaces unconditional upward and final-Fall assumptions with exact local behavior.

evidence.why: Unchecked arithmetic, state fallback, latch reset and consumers.

facts.value: Supplies the empty IASA slot shared by quick and slow opening ledge-jump states. It reads no input and initiates no interruption. This does not make the entire opening phase uninterruptible: ledge physics can route an invalid ledge to Fall entry, and collision processing can invoke independent responses before the normal animation-driven launch.
facts.rationale: Active table proves the shared role while delegated branches invalidate guaranteed continuation.

evidence.why: Empty IASA is distinct from active physics and collision.
Both opening states bind this callback.
Invalid ledge causes an early exit call.
Delegated collision has independent response branches.

facts.value: Performs no local transition while ftAnim_IsFramesRemaining is true; otherwise forwards gobj to ftCo_Fall_Enter. That callee first handles Master Hand and Crazy Hand specially, then routes x2224_b2 to ftCo_80090780 or a successful ftCo_800C5240 check to ftCo_800C5D34. Only if those alternatives do not apply does it initialize ordinary ftCo_MS_Fall with Ft_MF_KeepFastFall, frame 0, rate 1 and zero blend, clamp air drift, initialize fall scratch and conditionally convert ground to air. The wrapper does not guarantee the final motion.
facts.rationale: Independently verifies and expands the librarian's inline-gate qualification without assigning unsupported meanings to address-named alternate helpers.

evidence.why: Complete local guard and forwarding body.
Inline gate and all ordinary-entry conditions are explicit.
